- The SDK passes the same live custody/requester/source fence into both admission and effects. The direct delivery path carries it into execution, and the fallback checks it again in `onPlatformSendDispatch` after asynchronous preparation ([SDK owner](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5c730848d29b4f368139f335944b6b117325fcec/src/plugin-sdk/agent-harness-completion.ts#L89), [final dispatch](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5c730848d29b4f368139f335944b6b117325fcec/src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-completion-delivery.ts#L347)). The existing test changes source ownership inside the send adapter, awaits that actual dispatch callback, and proves zero platform sends ([boundary regression](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5c730848d29b4f368139f335944b6b117325fcec/src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts#L2025)).
